entries.rationale: Every case measures T.stacklevel directly, including reader and protected-depth transitions; the whole fixture requires real T.
Every scalar NOT operation is executed inside T.alloccount refusal; its prepared values are setup for that campaign.
All22 named operations exercise T.testC or other real T C API commands; no ordinary default branch exists.
All14 named operations exercise T.checkpanic and real T provider/child controls; the loadfile helper is retained as a separate ordinary fixture.
All four reader phases arm and restore real T.alloccount around their public reader/load assertions.
All four string/error phases arm and restore real T.alloccount around their public operation assertions.
All five transitions install actual C hooks through T.sethook; public hook-event assertions remain executed in the instrumented pair.
